titre: Devoir de synthèse n°1 - Anglais (9ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Last summer, my family and I travelled to the south of Tunisia. We visited the desert near Douz, which people call "the gateway to the Sahara". It was an unforgettable experience. We rode camels across the golden dunes and watched a magnificent sunset over the sand. At night, we slept in a traditional tent and listened to local music around a fire. The people we met were very friendly and welcoming. Although the weather was extremely hot during the day, the nights were cool and pleasant. I took hundreds of photos to remember this amazing trip.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) Where did the writer travel last summer?   (1,5 marks)
2) Give two activities the family did in the desert.   (2 marks)
3) What were the people they met like?   (1,5 marks)
4) "It was an unforgettable experience." What does "it" refer to?   (1 mark)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verbs in the past simple: We (ride) ______ camels and (watch) ______ a sunset.   (2 marks)
2) Give the comparative and superlative of "hot".   (2 marks)
3) Complete with the correct linker (although / because / so): ______ the weather was hot, the nights were cool.   (1 mark)
4) Find in the text an adjective that means "wonderful" = ______.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
Write about a trip or a holiday you enjoyed (about 12 lines). Say where you went, who you were with, what you did and how you felt. Use the past simple.
